title: Jerry S NDE 22125
content: When I was seven years old my oldest brother asked me to go across the highway to get a pack of cigarettes from a vending machine. Our next door neighbor was backing out while I was at the edge of the property. She accidentally backed into me and knocked me down. I got up, shook it off, and told her I was all right. When I looked back at the street, the only car I could see was so far away and it looked blurry, because of the heat and fumes. I started to cross the street and the next thing I know, I feel like I’ve woken up. I was looking down at people who were looking down at me laying on the street. I was all but dead. The people were saying something about, ‘go get his sister, his sister lives over there,’ or something like that. What I remember is I willed myself back to my body after hearing that. With this accident, that is it. The rest are memories from healing in the hospital.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death I was hit by a car while crossing a highway. It was a hit and run.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I don’t know if I had a form. Never thought about it until you asked. I always thought of it as a mind experience, while the body laid on the ground.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I seemed to be alert to what was going on. But only around the place where I lay.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I was looking down at people and my body on the ground.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes I felt like I was the light. Or in the light. And I was looking down at the neighbors who were looking at my body.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I could see what was going on at the accident scene. It was like tunnel vision. I could hear the bystanders. I felt confusion at first, and then determination to get my body back.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Puzzlement at first, then a desire to get back to my body before it died.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I seem to remember concentrating on my physical body, like, willing my mind and body back into one piece.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I seem to remember concentrating on my physical body, like, willing my mind and body back into one piece. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: No But how do you explain any near death experience so that somebody can truly understand it?
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I have had psychic experiences since then. I have read up on these experiences. My feelings are ambivalent.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best and worst thing about the entire experience? That I survived.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Maybe a momentary, 'wow!' at lunchtime, but that's about it.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: Yes I was doing mushrooms in Florida, and staying up all night. The next day, getting a ride home, I had an out of body experience. My spirit was up by the head rest of the car in an otherworldly sort of way. I was sixteen years old. It was 1983.
